answer: Someone running 73 aliases thus needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in ridge, expire in yarrow, and river lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3149 identities would post 2582 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
